Formula / 公式与单位 轻阻尼时共振频率接近固有频率；不要求共振曲线定量方程。 For lightly damped systems, the resonance frequency is close to the natural frequency. No quantitative resonance-curve equation is required. Conditions / 条件与范围 U2 对共振采用定性处理；稳定受迫振动的频率由驱动源决定。 Treat resonance qualitatively in U2. In steady forced vibration, oscillation frequency is set by the driver. Explanation / 解释 自由、受迫与共振 / Free, forced and resonant motion 自由振动是在初始扰动后没有持续周期性驱动的振动；它仍可有阻尼。稳态受迫振动的频率等于驱动频率；振幅取决于驱动频率、驱动力和阻尼。不能将所有受迫或阻尼运动一概称为理想简谐运动。 Free oscillation occurs after an initial disturbance without continuing periodic driving; it may still be damped. Steady forced oscillation follows the driving frequency, with amplitude depending on frequency, driving force and damping. 驱动频率接近系统固有频率时，能量传递效率大，出现共振峰。阻尼越大，共振峰越低、越宽，响应选择性越弱；轻阻尼时峰值频率接近固有频率。 Resonance gives a large response when the driving frequency is close to the natural frequency. Increasing damping lowers and broadens the peak; with light damping the peak is close to the natural frequency. 实例与图像判断 / Examples and graph interpretation 巴顿摆：与驱动摆长度相近的摆固有频率接近，振幅最大。桥梁、机器或悬架需控制不利共振；乐器弦和空气柱可利用共振增强特定频率。 In Barton's pendulums, the pendulum with a matching natural frequency has the largest response. Resonance can be controlled in bridges and machines or used to reinforce selected frequencies in instruments. 驻波只有在边界允许的频率出现稳定波节、波腹；扫描驱动频率时，合适频率处振幅显著增大。共振图横轴是驱动频率、纵轴是稳态振幅，不是位移随时间图。 Standing-wave resonances occur at frequencies allowed by the boundaries. A resonance curve plots steady amplitude against driving frequency, not displacement against time. 逐项覆盖 / Requirement-by-requirement coverage： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/01 考纲框架/00 U2知识覆盖核对 - Syllabus coverage audit 3.5.2 受迫振动和共振 / FORCED VIBRATIONS AND RESONANCE 3.5.2 原课件图像 / Source diagrams [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram 图像按原课件来源保留，解释与公式以本页考纲范围为准。 Original teaching images are retained; the text and conditions above define the assessed scope. U2 Resonance damping Physics diagram 共振定性图：阻尼增大，峰值降低并展宽；轻阻尼峰接近固有频率。仅读图，不要求此曲线方程。 Qualitative resonance curves. Applications / 应用与实验 例子包括秋千、弦、耦合摆以及结构的不希望振动；说明共振利用与阻尼防护。 Examples include a swing, vibrating strings, coupled pendulums and unwanted vibration in structures. Explain both useful resonance and the need for damping. Common errors / 易错点 自由振动本身不能称为共振。 Resonance is a response to periodic driving, not simply a system oscillating freely. 真题检验与答题思路 / Exam coverage and approaches Formula / 公式与单位 相位差可用弧度、角度或周期分数表示。 c=f\lambda ; f=1/T ; \Delta\phi=2\pi\Delta x/\lambda=2\pi\Delta t/T in radians, or 360^\circ\Delta x/\lambda . Conditions / 条件与范围 空间相位关系用于同一行波的不同位置；时间相位关系比较固定位置的周期阶段。 Spatial phase formula applies to points on the same progressive wave; time separation compares equivalent cycles at a fixed point. Explanation / 解释 介质振动与能量传播 / Oscillation and propagation 行波传递能量而不造成介质的整体净迁移；介质粒子在各自平衡位置附近振动。机械波需要介质，电磁波是场的振动，不需要物质介质。 A progressive wave transfers energy without bulk transport of the medium. Particles oscillate around their equilibrium positions; electromagnetic waves are field oscillations and need no material medium. 位移—距离图是一瞬间的波形，读出 A 和 \lambda ；位移—时间图是一粒子的振动，读出 A 和 T 。 f=1/T 、 c=f\lambda ；波速不是粒子振动速度。 A displacement–distance graph gives amplitude and wavelength at an instant; a displacement–time graph gives amplitude and period for one point. Wave speed is different from particle velocity. 相位与相位差 / Phase and phase difference 相位表示一个振动在周期中的状态，不仅是位移大小，还包括运动方向。同相要求处于同一周期阶段；位移同为零的两点也可能反相。 Phase identifies the stage of an oscillation, including its direction of motion. Equal displacement alone does not imply equal phase. 同频行波同一时刻两点相距 \Delta x ： \Delta\phi=2\pi\Delta x/\lambda ；同一点相隔 \Delta t ： \Delta\phi=2\pi\Delta t/T 。一周期 =360^\circ=2\pi\,\mathrm{rad} ；半周期为反相，整数周期为同相。 For a single-frequency progressive wave, phase differences follow 2\pi\Delta x/\lambda or 2\pi\Delta t/T . Half a cycle is antiphase and whole cycles are in phase. 已知传播方向时，可把波形向前稍移判断某粒子接下来的位移方向；不可用波峰向右移动来断定介质粒子也向右移动。 Translate the waveform slightly in the propagation direction to infer a particle's next displacement; travelling crests do not imply bulk particle motion in that direction. 逐项覆盖 / Requirement-by-requirement coverage： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/01 考纲框架/00 U2知识覆盖核对 - Syllabus coverage audit 3.5.3 行波 / PROGRESSIVE WAVES 3.5.3 原课件图像 / Source diagrams [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram 图像按原课件来源保留，解释与公式以本页考纲范围为准。 Original teaching images are retained; the text and conditions above define the assessed scope. Applications / 应用与实验 从图像读取振幅、波长、相位，并用传播距离和时间求波速。 Read amplitude, wavelength and phase from graphs; use time of flight and distance to find speed. Common errors / 易错点 振幅为平衡位置到波峰，非峰谷距离；反相点可相隔半波长。 Amplitude is measured from equilibrium to a crest, not crest to trough. Adjacent antiphase points can be half a wavelength apart. 真题检验与答题思路 / Exam coverage and approaches 依据本库现有真题与评分标准核对。下列步骤按题型使用，先核对题设条件；综合题需结合其他关联知识点。 / Checked against the papers and mark schemes held profile to determine particle motion. 2. \Delta\phi=2\pi\Delta x/\lambda ，有初始相位差时也要加上；相位相同可相差整数个 2\pi 。 / Combine initial and propagation phase differences. 3. 固定距离 L 上周期数为 fL/v ；问频率增大后的下一次同相，要找下一个整数。 / Use the next integer cycle count. 4. 载波周期、脉冲宽度、脉冲重复周期是不同量； N=f\Delta t 用的是题目对应的频率。 / Separate carrier frequency from pulse repetition frequency. 5. 滚筒记录先由周长和转动周期求纸速，再把图上距离变为时间差，最后用波速求传播距离。 / Convert Formula / 公式与单位 往返超声时间对应的深度须除以二。 Echo distance d=ct/2 for a pulse travelling to an interface and back. Conditions / 条件与范围 不要求马吕斯定律；所有电磁波在真空中速率相同，电场和磁场的振动为横向。 Malus’s law is not required. All electromagnetic waves have the same speed in vacuum; their electric and magnetic fields oscillate transversely. Explanation / 解释 横波、纵波与电磁波 / Transverse, longitudinal and EM waves 横波：粒子位移或场振动垂直于能量传播方向，如弦波、电磁波；纵波：粒子位移平行于能量传播方向，如空气中的声波，表现为疏部和密部。 Transverse oscillations are perpendicular to energy propagation, as on strings and in EM waves. Longitudinal oscillations are parallel, as in sound in air, with compressions and rarefactions. 电磁波的电场、磁场振动互相垂直，并都垂直于传播方向；各种电磁波在真空中速率相同， c\approx3.00\times10^8\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}} ，在介质中可不同。 Electric and magnetic fields in an EM wave oscillate mutually perpendicular and perpendicular to propagation. All EM waves have the same speed in vacuum; speeds in materials can differ. 偏振证据与天线 / Polarisation and aerials 平面偏振把横波的振动限制在一个方向（相应振动平面包含传播方向）。非偏振光通过偏振片后成为平面偏振光；第二片与第一片透振方向平行时最亮、垂直时最暗。 Plane polarisation restricts transverse oscillations to one direction. Unpolarised light becomes polarised after a polariser; a second aligned polariser gives maximum transmission and a crossed one gives minimum transmission. 纵波只有沿传播方向的振动，不能通过这种方式偏振，因此偏振现象是横波证据。发射、接收天线应方向匹配，以有效发射和接收同一偏振的无线电波。只要求定性分析，不要求马吕斯定律。 Longitudinal waves cannot be polarised in this way. Polarisation therefore demonstrates transverse behaviour. Transmitting and receiving aerials should be aligned. Malus's law is not required. 超声脉冲回波 / Ultrasound pulse echoes 超声频率高于人耳听觉上限（约20 kHz）。探头发出短脉冲，组织界面反射部分声能，探头接收回波；深度 d=ct/2 ， t 是往返时间。扫描探头可确定组织边界位置。 Ultrasound is above the human hearing range, about 20 kHz. Short pulses reflect partly at tissue boundaries. Depth is ct/2 because the measured delay is a round trip; scanning locates boundaries. 脉冲需足够短以分辨相近界面，间隔需足够长以等回波返回；凝胶排除皮肤与探头间的空气、改善声能耦合。医学超声使用非电离声波。 Short pulses resolve nearby boundaries; adequate intervals allow echoes to return. Gel removes air gaps and improves coupling. Medical ultrasound uses non-ionising sound waves. 逐项覆盖 / Requirement-by-requirement coverage： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/01 考纲框架/00 U2知识覆盖核对 - Syllabus coverage audit 3.5.4 纵波和横波 / LONGITUDINAL AND TRANSVERSE WAVES 3.5.4 原课件图像 / Source diagrams [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram 图像按原课件来源保留，解释与公式以本页考纲范围为准。 Original teaching images are retained; the text and conditions above define the assessed scope. Applications / 应用与实验 偏振片降低反射眩光，发射与接收天线需要匹配方向；用反射与脉冲计时解释超声成像。 Polaroid filters reduce reflected glare. Transmitting and receiving aerials need matching orientations. Explain ultrasound imaging using reflection and pulse timing. Common errors / 易错点 声波振动的是介质粒子，电磁波振动的是场；电磁波不需要介质。 Describe the oscillating quantity: medium particles for sound, fields for electromagnetic waves. Electromagnetic waves do not require a material medium. 真题检验与答题思路 / Exam coverage and approaches 依据本库现有真题与评分标准核对。下列步骤按题型使用，先核对题设条件；综合题需结合其他关联知识点。 / Checked against the papers and mark schemes held in are mutually perpendicular, transverse and in phase. - 旋转检偏器：线偏振光的强度连续变化，一周两次极大、两次极小；非偏振光通过理想检偏器时强度不随角度改变。当前考纲不要求额外记忆马吕斯定律。 / Describe the observed variation before inferring polarisation. - 金属栅中电场平行金属杆会驱动电子运动，波被衰减；透过的电场分量垂直金属杆。接收天线应沿接收电场方向。 / Distinguish the transmitting axis of a grille from the axis of an aerial. - 移动电话方向会变化，说明为何不能只考虑单一固定接收方向。 / Connect polarisation to the use case. Formula / 公式与单位 弦张力用 F 表示，避免与周期 T 混淆；两端固定弦的第 n 谐波含 n 个波腹。 f_1=\frac{1}{2L}\sqrt{F/\mu} ; \mu=m/L ; \lambda_n=2L/n and f_n=nf_1 for a string fixed at both ends. Conditions / 条件与范围 标准完整波节图要求反向波同频、等振幅；弦需均匀且两端固定。采用“第一谐波”和“谐波”术语。 For the standard complete-node pattern, the counter-propagating waves have equal frequency and equal amplitude. String relationships assume uniform linear density and both ends fixed. Use “first harmonic” and “harmonics”. Explanation / 解释 叠加形成驻波 / Superposition and formation 重叠时合位移是各列波位移的代数和。相同频率、同一介质中沿相反方向传播的波叠加，可形成固定波节和波腹；完全波节要求两波振幅相等。常见情形是入射波与反射波叠加。 Resultant displacement is the algebraic sum of component displacements. Counter-propagating waves of the same frequency can form fixed nodes and antinodes; complete nodes require equal amplitudes. 画图时选几个相隔四分之一周期的时刻，将两波逐点相加：波节始终为零，波腹在最大正位移、零、最大负位移间变化。驻波无沿波传播方向的净能量传递，但各点仍可振动。 Add the two waveforms point by point at successive quarter-cycle intervals. Nodes remain at zero while antinodes oscillate. An ideal stationary wave has no net energy transfer along the wave. 间距、相位与谐波 / Spacing, phase and harmonics 相邻波节或相邻波腹相距 \lambda/2 ，相邻波节与波腹相距 \lambda/4 。同一对相邻波节内的振动同相，跨过一个波节反相；波节处振幅为零，不给它指定振动相位。 Adjacent nodes or antinodes are separated by half a wavelength; a node and its adjacent antinode by a quarter wavelength. Points within one loop are in phase; adjacent loops are in antiphase. Phase is undefined at a node. 两端固定弦的第 n 谐波： L=n\lambda_n/2 ， f_n=nf_1 ， f_1=(1/2L)\sqrt{\mathcal T/\mu} ， \mu=m/L 。这里 \mathcal T 表示张力，避免与周期 T 混淆。采用 first harmonic、second harmonic 等术语。 For a string fixed at both ends, L=n\lambda_n/2 and f_n=nf_1 . Use harmonic terminology; distinguish tension from period. 三种装置与变量关系 / Apparatus and variable relationships 弦：振动发生器驱动并调频观察波腹。微波：发射器、反射板和探头测相邻极小值间距。声波：声源、反射端和麦克风测声强变化；由相邻波节间距求 \lambda ，再用 c=f\lambda 。 Use a vibrator and string, a microwave transmitter with reflector and probe, or a sound source with reflector and microphone. Adjacent minima give half the wavelength, allowing wave speed to be found. 研究弦频率时一次改变一个量： f\propto1/L 、 f\propto\sqrt{\mathcal T} 、 f\propto1/\sqrt\mu ；可作 f – 1/L 、 f^2 – \mathcal T 、 f^2 – 1/\mu 图，保持同一谐波。 Change one variable at a time and keep the harmonic fixed. U2 Stationary wave formation Physics diagram 同频、等振幅、反向传播波的逐点叠加；波节位置固定。 Superposition at three instants; fixed nodes. Applications / 应用与实验 实验研究频率与弦长、张力、线密度关系；声波或微波驻波可由连续极大、极小位置识别。 Investigate frequency against string length, tension and mass per unit length. Sound or microwave standing waves can be detected by successive maxima/minima. 2. 波腹处两波同相、波节处反相；不能说两列反向行波处处同相。振幅不等时极大 A_1+A_2 ，极小 A_1-A_2 ，极小未必为零。 / A minimum need not be a true node when amplitudes differ. 3. 固定两端的弦先数半波段， L=n\lambda/2 ；相邻波节间同相、跨一个波节反相。选谐波的拨弦点应在相应波腹。 / Count Formula / 公式与单位 同相源增强与相消分别对应整波长和奇数半波长程差；双缝条纹间距与波长、屏距成正比，与缝距成反比。 For in-phase sources: constructive \Delta x=n\lambda , destructive \Delta x=(n+\tfrac12)\lambda . Double-slit fringe spacing w=\lambda D/s . Conditions / 条件与范围 条纹间距近似需屏距远大于缝距且角度小；完全相消还需振幅相等；相干不要求相位差为零。 The fringe-spacing approximation requires D\gg s and small angles. Complete cancellation additionally requires equal amplitudes. Coherence does not require zero phase difference. Explanation / 解释 相干、程差与明暗 / Coherence and interference conditions 相干源具有相同频率和恒定相位差。来自同一源的双缝可保持相干；两个独立灯泡的相位差随机变化，不能形成稳定条纹。 Coherent sources have the same frequency and a constant phase difference. Two slits illuminated by one source are coherent; independent lamps do not maintain a stable relative phase. 两源同相时，程差 \delta=n\lambda 为相长， \delta=(n+1/2)\lambda 为相消；完全相消还需两波在该处振幅相等。若两源初相不同，应先加上初相差，不能直接套程差判据。 For in-phase sources, whole-wavelength path differences give constructive interference and odd half-wavelengths give destructive interference. Complete cancellation requires equal amplitudes; include any initial source phase difference. 声波可用同一信号发生器驱动双扬声器，以麦克风检测强弱交替；微波用接收器检测极大和极小。 Drive two speakers from one generator and detect alternating loud and quiet positions; use a receiver for analogous microwave maxima and minima. 双缝间距与白光 / Double-slit spacing and white light w=\lambda D/s 适用于远屏、小角度且两缝间距 s 已知的情形。 w 是相邻亮条纹之间或相邻暗条纹之间的距离；亮到相邻暗才是 w/2 。改变 \lambda,D,s 的影响应逐一判断。 The double-slit spacing equation uses the small-angle, distant-screen approximation. Adjacent bright fringes and adjacent dark fringes have the same spacing w ; bright to neighbouring dark is w/2 . 白光中央程差为零，各色相长形成白色中央条纹；两侧形成彩色条纹，红光离中心更远、紫光更近，远处不同级次重叠后难以辨认。 With white light the central zero-path-difference fringe is white. Coloured side fringes have red farther from the centre and violet nearer it; overlap eventually washes out the pattern. 必做实验5及安全 / Required practical 5 and safety 双缝实验测 D 、已知 s ，跨多个条纹测总宽后除以间隔数，用 \lambda=ws/D ；区分“条纹条数”和“间隔数”。光栅实验参见3.5.7，以两侧同级亮斑求角度。 Measure several fringe spacings and divide by the number of intervals, then calculate wavelength. The grating part is developed in 3.5.7 using matching orders on both sides. 低功率激光固定在眼睛高度以下，避免直视及镜面反射，用屏接收；不要求激光器内部工作原理。 Secure a low-power laser below eye level, avoid direct and specularly reflected beams, and use a screen. Laser operating details are not required. 逐项覆盖 / Requirement-by-requirement coverage： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/01 考纲框架/00 U2知识覆盖核对 - Syllabus coverage audit 3.5.6 干涉 / INTERFERENCE 3.5.6 Applications / 应用与实验 必做实验 5：跨多个条纹间隔测量，求平均间距，测屏距和缝距，求波长与不确定度；注意声波、微波干涉；避免直视激光及镜面反射。 Required practical 5: measure several fringe spacings, divide by the number of intervals, measure D and s , calculate wavelength and uncertainty. Explain sound and microwave interference. Never look into a laser beam or its specular reflection. Common errors / 易错点 数条纹间隔而非亮纹个数；两个独立灯通常不相干。 Count the number of intervals, not the number of bright fringes. Two independent lamps are not normally coherent. 真题检验与答题思路 / Exam coverage and approaches 依据本库现有真题与评分标准核对。下列步骤按题型使用，先核对题设条件；综合题需结合其他关联知识点。 / Checked against the papers and mark schemes held in this vault; select the approach that fits the stated conditions. 3.5.6 方法 1 · 干涉的路径与相位账目 / Path and phase accounting 1. 明确两条实际路径并求 \Delta s ；距离不满足远场条件时用几何长度，不能盲用 w=\lambda D/s 。 / Calculate the actual paths before using a far-field approximation. 2. 总相位差 \Delta\phi_{total}=\Delta\phi_{initial}+2\pi\Delta s/\lambda ；相干要求同频和恒定相位差，完全相消还需要相等振幅。 / Coherence alone does not guarantee zero intensity. 3. 接收器在相向两声源间移动 x 时，路程差改变 2x ；只移动一个声源时通常改变 x 。 / Identify which paths change. 4. 镜面移动 d 使往返光程改变 2d ，相邻亮暗对应 d=\lambda/4 ，相邻亮纹为 \lambda/2 。 / Include the return path in an interferometer. 5. Formula / 公式与单位 缝距为每米刻线数的倒数；最大级次受正弦不超过一限制。 d\sin\theta=n\lambda ; d=1/(\text{lines per metre}) ; permitted orders satisfy n\lambda/d\leq1 . Conditions / 条件与范围 光栅方程用于平面透射光栅、正入射；不要求分光计操作或单缝强度—角度曲线。 Use the grating equation for a plane transmission grating at normal incidence. A spectrometer’s operation and a single-slit intensity-versus-angle graph are not required. Explanation / 解释 单缝图样与改变条件 / Single-slit pattern 单色光单缝图样有明亮、较宽的中央极大，两侧有较弱、较窄的亮纹并由暗区分隔；图样关于中央对称。增大波长或减小缝宽会增大中央极大宽度。这里要求定性变化，不把单缝强度—角度函数列为必学内容。 A single slit produces a broad bright central maximum and weaker, narrower side maxima separated by minima. Longer wavelength or a narrower slit broadens the central maximum. Only qualitative width changes are required. 白光中央为白色，两侧有彩色边缘，较长波长的红光偏离中心更多。需区分单缝中央极大与双缝等间距干涉条纹。 White light gives a white centre and coloured side regions, with red extending farther out. Distinguish the broad single-slit maximum from double-slit fringe spacing. 光栅方程的几何推导 / Deriving the grating equation 平面透射光栅正入射：相邻缝到同一出射方向的程差为 d\sin\theta ；第 n 级主极大要求程差 n\lambda ，故 d\sin\theta=n\lambda 。 \theta 从光栅法线量起， d 是相邻缝中心距。 At normal incidence, adjacent slits have path difference d\sin\theta . Constructive interference gives d\sin\theta=n\lambda , with angle measured from the grating normal. 若线密度为每毫米 N 条， d=10^{-3}/N 米。最高级次满足 n\lambda\le d ；左右的 +n 、 -n 对称，对应同一级而不是两个不同级次。相同级次下长波长的衍射角更大。 Convert line density to spacing in metres. Allowed orders satisfy n\lambda\le d . Equal orders occur symmetrically on both sides; longer wavelengths have larger angles at a fixed order. 测量与光谱应用 / Measurement and applications 可从屏上位移求 \theta=\tan^{-1}(x/D) ，再代光栅方程； x 是中央到一侧亮斑的距离，不能把两侧间距直接代入。使用多级次或双侧读数比较，可减少定位误差。 Calculate the angle from screen geometry before using the grating equation. Use centre-to-order distance, or halve the separation of symmetric orders. Compare several orders or both sides to reduce alignment error. 光栅把不同波长分开，用于测波长、分析元素线谱。考纲不考分光计操作细节；光栅观察仍遵守激光安全。 Gratings separate wavelengths for wavelength measurement and spectral identification. Spectrometer operation is excluded; laser precautions still apply. 逐项覆盖 / Requirement-by-requirement coverage： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/01 考纲框架/00 U2知识覆盖核对 - Syllabus coverage audit 3.5.7 衍射 / DIFFRACTION 3.5.7 原课件图像 / Source diagrams [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram 图像按原课件来源保留，解释与公式以本页考纲范围为准。 Original teaching images are retained; the text and conditions above define the assessed scope. Applications / 应用与实验 光栅用于分辨波长、分析光谱；实验中测左右角度取平均，注意每毫米到每米的刻线数换算。 Use diffraction gratings to distinguish wavelengths and analyse spectra. For practical 5, measure angles on both sides and average; convert lines per mm to lines per m. Common errors / 易错点 中央为零级；计算总主极大数时通常包括左右两侧和中央。 The central maximum is order zero. Maxima occur symmetrically on both sides; a count of total maxima usually includes both sides and the central one. 真题检验与答题思路 / Exam coverage and approaches and gratings 1. 单缝变窄：衍射更明显、中央极大变宽；同一入射光束下透过光减少，中央强度降低。中央极大宽度约为邻近次级极大的两倍。 / Describe width and intensity separately. 2. 光栅常数 d=1/N （先把线密度统一为每米）；对称两侧亮纹夹角的一半才是 \theta 。 / Convert line density and identify the measured angle. 3. 用 d\sin\theta=n\lambda 逐级计算， \theta_n 不是 n\theta_1 。 n_{max}=\lfloor d/\lambda\rfloor ，总亮点数通常 2n_{max}+1 ，另检查屏幕范围及是否存在掠射阶。 / Apply the sine condition and visibility limits. 4. 级次重叠满足 n_1\lambda_1=n_2\lambda_2 。增加线密度使给定级次角度较大，可降低固定读数误差的相对影响，但应仍能观测该级。 / Separate order overlap from resolution of a measurement. 5. 推导按“相邻缝路程差 d\sin\theta → 整数波长时相长”；衍射不是偏振。 / State the Formula / 公式与单位 空气折射率近似为一；角度均从法线量起。 n=c/c_{\mathrm{s}} ; n_1\sin\theta_1=n_2\sin\theta_2 ; \sin\theta_c=n_2/n_1 for n_1 n_2 . Conditions / 条件与范围 全反射需从高折射率向低折射率传播且入射角大于临界角；光纤限阶跃型。 Total internal reflection needs both high-to-low refractive index propagation and incidence above the critical angle. Fibres are limited to step-index types. Explanation / 解释 折射率与法线 / Refractive index and normals n=c/c_s ，空气 n\approx1 。光过静止界面时频率不变；在更大折射率介质中速率和波长更小。斯涅尔定律 n_1\sin\theta_1=n_2\sin\theta_2 的两个角均从法线量起。 Frequency is unchanged across a stationary interface; speed and wavelength decrease in a higher-index medium. Both angles in Snell's law are measured from the normal. 从低折射率进入高折射率介质时向法线偏折，反之远离法线；正入射时方向不变，但速率和波长仍可改变。 Light bends towards the normal on entering a higher-index medium and away on leaving it. At normal incidence direction is unchanged, although speed and wavelength may change. 临界角与阶跃光纤 / Critical angle and step-index fibres 全反射同时需要 n_1 n_2 和 \theta_i \theta_c 。临界角处折射角为 90^\circ ，由斯涅尔定律得到 \sin\theta_c=n_2/n_1 ；不是反正切关系。 Total internal reflection requires travel from higher to lower index and incidence above the critical angle. Snell's law gives \sin\theta_c=n_2/n_1 , not an inverse-tangent expression. 阶跃光纤的纤芯折射率高于包层；合适光线在芯—包层边界多次全反射。包层维持可控边界并保护芯、减少相邻光纤串扰；弯曲过紧会破坏全反射条件。 A step-index fibre has a higher-index core than cladding. Suitable rays undergo repeated total internal reflection. Cladding maintains the boundary, protects the core and reduces cross-talk; excessive bending can permit leakage. 两类色散、吸收及后果 / Dispersion and absorption 模式色散：不同传播路径长度不同，抵达时间不同；细纤芯、限制入射角范围可减小。材料色散：折射率和波速随波长变化，多波长脉冲抵达时间不同；窄光谱光源可减小。 Modal dispersion comes from different path lengths; a narrow core or restricted ray angles reduces it. Material dispersion comes from wavelength-dependent refractive index and speed; a narrow spectral source reduces it. 两种色散都导致脉冲展宽，相邻脉冲可重叠而限制数据率。吸收把光能转移到材料，使幅度和强度减小、信噪比变差；吸收不是脉冲展宽的同义词。 Both forms of dispersion broaden pulses and can limit data rate through overlap. Absorption transfers light energy to the material and reduces amplitude and intensity; it is different from dispersion. 逐项覆盖 / Requirement-by-requirement coverage： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/01 考纲框架/00 U2知识覆盖核对 - Syllabus coverage audit 3.5.8 平面界面处的折射 / REFRACTION AT A PLANE SURFACE 3.5.8 原课件图像 / Source diagrams [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram 图像按原课件来源保留，解释与公式以本页考纲范围为准。 Original teaching images are retained; the text and conditions above define the assessed scope. Formula / 公式与单位 电子伏特是能量单位；发射光子的能量为上下能级差，X射线最高光子能量受加速电压限制。 1\,\mathrm{eV}=1.602\times10^{-19}\,\mathrm{J} ; emitted photon hf=E_{\mathrm{upper}}-E_{\mathrm{lower}} ; electron accelerated through V gains eV ; X-ray maximum photon energy =eV . Conditions / 条件与范围 束缚能级间的单光子吸收要求光子能量匹配允许能级差；碰撞电子可转移激发所需能量并保留余能。电离需达到移走电子所需能量；用SI普朗克常量计算前将eV换算为J。 Single-photon absorption between bound levels requires a matching energy gap. Colliding electrons can retain surplus kinetic energy. Ionisation requires sufficient removal energy; convert eV to J before using SI Planck constant. Explanation / 解释 激发、电离与荧光灯 / Excitation, ionisation and lamps 激发使束缚电子升到更高允许能级；电离使电子脱离原子。碰撞电子只需具备足够能量，可在碰撞后带走余能；吸收一个光子造成束缚能级跃迁时，光子能量需匹配能级差。 Excitation raises a bound electron to a higher allowed level; ionisation removes it. A colliding electron can retain surplus kinetic energy, whereas absorption for a bound-to-bound transition requires a matching photon energy. 荧光灯：电场加速电子→与低压汞蒸气原子碰撞、使其激发或电离→原子退激发发紫外光→荧光涂层吸收紫外并发可见光。能量从高能光子转为较低能可见光，不能把涂层说成简单反射紫外光。 Accelerated electrons excite or ionise mercury atoms. De-excitation produces UV photons; the phosphor absorbs UV and emits visible light rather than merely reflecting UV. 能级、谱线与单位 / Energy levels, spectra and units 向低能级跃迁时 hf=E_{\rm upper}-E_{\rm lower}=hc/\lambda 0 。离散能级只允许离散光子能量，形成特征线谱；能级差越大，频率越高、波长越短。吸收谱对应能级向上跃迁。 Downward transitions emit photons whose energies equal the positive level difference. Discrete levels produce discrete spectral lines; a larger gap gives higher frequency and shorter wavelength. 1\,\mathrm{eV}=1.602\times10^{-19}\,\mathrm J ；eV 是能量单位，不是电势单位。能级若以电离极限为零，束缚能级为负值；计算仍取末、初状态之差。 An electron volt is an energy unit, not a voltage. Bound levels are negative when zero energy is at the ionisation limit; use state differences consistently. X射线管与特征辐射 / X-ray tube and characteristic radiation 加热阴极释放电子，真空中高电压将电子加速到金属靶阳极。大部分电子能量成为热，部分成为X射线。连续谱来自电子减速；特征线来自内层空位被更高能级电子填充，其能量取决于靶元素。 A heated cathode emits electrons, accelerated through a vacuum towards a metal target. Most energy becomes heat. Braking produces a continuous spectrum; inner-shell transitions produce characteristic lines determined by the target element. 单个电子最大能量 eV 给出 hf_{\max}=eV 、 \lambda_{\min}=hc/(eV) ；提高管电压减小最短波长，但不改变同一靶元素的特征能级差。医学成像利用不同组织吸收不同，骨骼等高吸收部位形成对比。 The maximum photon energy is eV , giving a minimum wavelength. Increasing tube voltage changes the cutoff, not the target's characteristic level gaps. Medical imaging uses differential absorption by tissues. 逐项覆盖 / Requirement-by-requirement coverage： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/01 考纲框架/00 U2知识覆盖核对 - Syllabus coverage audit 3.5.9 电子与原子的碰撞 / COLLISIONS OF ELECTRONS WITH ATOMS 3.5.9 原课件图像 / Source diagrams [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram 图像按原课件来源保留，解释与公式以本页考纲范围为准。 Original teaching images are retained; the text and conditions above define the assessed scope. Applications / 应用与实验 医学成像利用组织吸收差异；电子流改变影响强度，加速电压改变影响最高光子能量。 Medical X-ray images exploit different absorption by tissues. Explain changes to intensity when electron current changes and maximum photon energy when accelerating voltage changes. Common errors / 易错点 电离不同于升到另一束缚能级；光子能量来自能级差而非单个能级数值。 Ionisation is removal, not simply promotion to another bound level. Formula / 公式与单位 光子能量用于克服逸出功和提供最大光电子动能。 E=hf=hc/\lambda ; hf=\phi+E_{k,\max} ; \phi=hf_0 ; E_{k,\max}=eV_{\mathrm{stop}} . Conditions / 条件与范围 不要求遏止电势的实验测定；比较强度作用时需固定高于截止频率的频率。 The experimental determination of stopping potential is not required. Compare intensity effects at fixed frequency above threshold. Explanation / 解释 光子与阈频 / Photons and threshold frequency 光与电子一次相互作用时，一个电子吸收一个光子的能量 hf 。只有 hf\ge\phi 才可逸出，故 f_0=\phi/h 。低于阈频时增加光强或照射时间仍不能引发该单光子光电发射。 One electron absorbs one photon's energy in the photoelectric model. Emission requires hf\ge\phi , so f_0=\phi/h . Below threshold, increasing intensity or exposure time does not produce single-photon emission. 在高于阈频、收集条件相同的情况下，增大光强提高单位时间入射光子数，通常提高光电流；增大频率提高单光子能量和光电子最大动能。 Above threshold, higher intensity increases photon arrival rate and normally photocurrent; higher frequency increases photon energy and maximum electron kinetic energy. 能量方程、最大值与遏止电势 / Energy and stopping potential hf=\phi+E_{k,\max} ；电子可能在离开前损失能量，所以该式给出最大动能，实际光电子具有一系列动能。 eV_s=E_{k,\max} ， V_s 是使最快光电子也无法到达收集极的最小反向电势差的大小。 The equation gives maximum kinetic energy; other electrons can lose energy before escape. Stopping potential is the minimum retarding pd that prevents even the fastest emitted electrons reaching the collector. 遏止电势消除收集光电流，不是阻止金属表面发射电子。考纲要求理解该量并计算，不要求实验测定遏止电势。 Stopping potential stops the collected current, not electron emission at the illuminated surface. Its experimental determination is excluded. 图像斜率与截距 / Gradients and intercepts E_{k,\max} – f 图：斜率 h ，纵截距 -\phi ，横截距 f_0 。 V_s – f 图：斜率 h/e ，纵截距 -\phi/e 。若能量轴用 eV，斜率的数值和单位需随之换算。 The maximum kinetic energy–frequency graph has gradient h and intercept -\phi . The stopping-potential graph has gradient h/e and intercept -\phi/e . Account for whether energy is plotted in joules or electron volts. 逐项覆盖 / Requirement-by-requirement coverage： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/01 考纲框架/00 U2知识覆盖核对 - Syllabus coverage audit 3.5.10 光电效应 / PHOTOELECTRIC EFFECT 3.5.10 原课件图像 / Source diagrams [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram 图像按原课件来源保留，解释与公式以本页考纲范围为准。 Original teaching images are retained; the text and conditions above define the assessed scope. U2 Photoelectric comparisons Physics diagram 动能—频率直线只在截止频率以上对应发射；负值区为延长线，不能解释为负动能。定频强度改变发射率，不改最大动能。 Extrapolated negative KE is not physical emission. Applications / 应用与实验 用逸出功和截止频率比较金属，并由遏止电势求最大动能。 Compare two metals through their work functions and thresholds; convert stopping potential to maximum kinetic energy. Common errors / 易错点 遏止电势是电压，需乘元电荷才得能量；并非所有光电子动能相同。 Stopping potential is a voltage, not an energy; multiply by elementary charge. Formula / 公式与单位 德布罗意波长与动量成反比；电子加速关系结合 U1 动能与动量公式。 \lambda=h/p=h/(mv) for non-relativistic particles. If accelerated from rest through V , p=\sqrt{2meV} . Conditions / 条件与范围 使用非相对论动量和动能模型；不要求具体粒子衍射方法的细节。 Use p=mv and E_k=\tfrac12mv^2 in the non-relativistic model. Details of particular particle-diffraction methods are not expected. Explanation / 解释 证据与模型发展 / Evidence and changing models 干涉、衍射支持光的波动描述，光电效应支持能量以光子为单位传递。电子具有质量和电荷，表现出粒子性；电子衍射又表明物质粒子有波动性质。使用哪种描述由实验决定，不是把光子想成沿正弦轨迹运动的小球。 Interference and diffraction support a wave description of light; the photoelectric effect supports photons. Electrons have particle properties and show diffraction. The appropriate model is determined by experimental evidence. 物理模型会随新证据修正：经典波模型不能解释阈频，单纯经典粒子模型不能解释电子衍射。考纲不要求特定粒子衍射装置的细节。 New evidence revises models: a classical wave-only model cannot explain threshold frequency, while a classical particle-only model cannot explain electron diffraction. Specific diffraction apparatus details are excluded. 动量与衍射程度 / Momentum and diffraction \lambda=h/p ；非相对论粒子 p=mv ， p=\sqrt{2mE_k} 。电子从静止经电压 V 加速时，可在非相对论近似下用 E_k=eV ，得到 \lambda=h/\sqrt{2meV} 。 Use \lambda=h/p . For nonrelativistic particles, p=mv=\sqrt{2mE_k} ; an electron accelerated from rest through a pd gains energy eV . 同一衍射结构下，动量增大→波长减小→衍射角减小、环半径减小。不可把高能核衍射电子一律用 p=mv ；若题目给出相对论关系，应使用题目关系。 For the same diffracting structure, larger momentum gives shorter wavelength and smaller diffraction angles or rings. Applications / 应用与实验 解释加速电压增加时衍射环变小，并准确表述实验支持的波动性质。 Explain smaller electron diffraction rings when accelerating voltage increases. Distinguish experimental evidence from a claim that particles simply become classical waves. Common errors / 易错点 波长由动量决定；不同质量粒子即使速率相同，波长也不同。 The relevant quantity is momentum, not speed alone; particles of different masses can have different wavelengths at the same speed. 真题检验与答题思路 / Exam text: RP3 电池电动势与内阻 / Required practical 3 - EMF and internal resistance A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.4 电学/3.4.6 电动势与内阻 - Electromotive force and internal resistance 3.4.6 电动势与内阻 <!-- QUANTITY_SYMBOLS_20261021_START -- 物理量与符号 / Quantities and symbols 符号沿用本节公式；若题目另有定义，以题设为准。 / These symbols follow this section; use any notation defined in the question. 物理量 / Quantity 符号 / Symbol SI单位 / SI unit 说明 / Notes --- --- --- --- 电动势 / electromotive force \varepsilon \mathrm{V} 是能量/电荷，不是力 / Energy per charge, not a force. 内阻 / internal resistance r \mathrm{\Omega} 与半径 r 按语境区分 / Not a radius in this context. 路端电势差 / terminal potential difference V \mathrm{V} 电流 / electric current I \mathrm{A} 与光强、转动惯量的 I 区分 / Not intensity or moment of inertia. 电阻 / resistance R \mathrm{\Omega} <!-- QUANTITY_SYMBOLS_20261021_END -- 方法、分析与误差 / Method, analysis and uncertainty 1 电池、变阻器和电流表串联，电压表并接电池。 Connect an ammeter in series with a cell and variable external resistance, and a voltmeter across the cell. 2 改变外阻取得一组电流，记录对应路端电压。 Change load resistance to obtain a range of currents; record the paired current and terminal voltage values. 3 控制电流，读数间断开，减少发热和电池变化。 Use modest currents, disconnect between readings and avoid cell heating or discharge drift. 4 作电压—电流图，截距求电动势、负斜率求内阻。 Plot V against I; intercept gives emf and the negative gradient gives internal resistance. 5 重复测量，并用合理极限线估计斜率和截距不确定度。 Repeat readings and assess gradient/intercept uncertainty using suitable limiting lines. 自检 / Retrieval - [ ] 画出装置并标出测量量 / Draw and label the apparatus. - [ ] 写出控制变量与数据表列 / State controls and data-table columns. - [ ] 解释图像斜率、截距及不确定度 / Interpret gradients, intercepts and uncertainty. 考纲依据 / Specification： 必做实验 3，3.4.6；教材相关页见对应知识节点。 定量分析与条件核对 / Quantitative analysis and controls A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.4 电学/3.4.6 电动势与内阻 - Electromotive force and internal resistance 必做实验3与线性图 / Required practical 3

text: RP4 弹簧振子与单摆 / Required practical 4 - Mass-spring system and simple pendulum A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.1 振动系统、能量与阻尼 - Oscillating systems 3.5.1 振动系统、能量与阻尼 <!-- QUANTITY_SYMBOLS_20261021_START -- 物理量与符号 / Quantities and symbols 符号沿用本节公式；若题目另有定义，以题设为准。 / These symbols follow this section; use any notation defined in the question. 物理量 / Quantity 符号 / Symbol SI单位 / SI unit 说明 / Notes --- --- --- --- 周期 / period T \mathrm{s} 与热力学温度 T 区分 / Not temperature in this context. 时间、时间间隔 / time, time interval t,\ \Delta t \mathrm{s} 频率 / frequency f \mathrm{Hz} 质量 / mass m \mathrm{kg} 与重力不同 / Not weight. 劲度系数 / spring constant, stiffness k \mathrm{N\,m^{-1}} 与导热系数、玻尔兹曼常量区分 / Not thermal conductivity or Boltzmann constant. 长度 / length L,\ l \mathrm{m} 按题目给出的记号 / Use the question's notation. 重力加速度、引力场强 / gravitational acceleration, field strength g \mathrm{m\,s^{-2}} 等效单位 N kg⁻¹；按所述物理量解释 / N kg⁻¹ is equivalent; interpret the quantity in context. 振幅 / amplitude A \mathrm{m} 位移振幅；与面积、活度 A 区分 / Displacement amplitude, not area or activity. <!-- QUANTITY_SYMBOLS_20261021_END -- 方法、分析与误差 / Method, analysis and uncertainty 1 多个完整周期计时再平均并重复。 Measure the period by timing many complete cycles and divide by the cycle count; repeat. 2 弹簧实验改变质量，保持弹簧与小振幅，作周期平方—质量图。 For a spring, vary the attached mass while keeping spring and small amplitude fixed; plot T² against m. 3 单摆测支点到球心长度，保持小角度，改变摆长并作周期平方图。 For a pendulum, measure pivot-to-bob-centre length, keep the angle small, vary length and plot T² against l. 4 两斜率分别为四π平方除劲度系数或重力加速度；数据不支持时不能强迫过原点。 Spring gradient is 4π²/k; pendulum gradient is 4π²/g. Include intercepts rather than forcing a fit through zero if data disagree. 5 控制释放方法，避免半周期计数，并讨论反应时间与长度、质量不确定度。 Control release method and avoid timing half cycles; discuss reaction time and length/mass uncertainties. 自检 / Retrieval - [ ] 画出装置并标出测量量 / Draw and label the apparatus. - [ ] 写出控制变量与数据表列 / State controls and data-table columns. - [ ] 解释图像斜率、截距及不确定度 / Interpret gradients, intercepts and uncertainty. 考纲依据 / Specification： 必做实验 4，3.5.1；教材相关页见对应知识节点。 定量分析与条件核对 / Quantitative analysis and controls A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.1 振动系统、能量与阻尼 - Oscillating systems 必做实验4 / Required practical 4

text: RP5 双缝与衍射光栅干涉 / Required practical 5 - Double-slit and diffraction-grating interference A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.6 干涉、相干与杨氏双缝 - Interference 3.5.6 干涉、相干与杨氏双缝 、 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.7 单缝衍射与光栅 - Diffraction 3.5.7 单缝衍射与光栅 <!-- QUANTITY_SYMBOLS_20261021_START -- 物理量与符号 / Quantities and symbols 符号沿用本节公式；若题目另有定义，以题设为准。 / These symbols follow this section; use any notation defined in the question. 物理量 / Quantity 符号 / Symbol SI单位 / SI unit 说明 / Notes --- --- --- --- 波长 / wavelength \lambda \mathrm{m} 与衰变常量 λ 区分 / Not decay constant. 条纹间距 / fringe spacing w \mathrm{m} 双缝到屏距离 / slit-to-screen distance D \mathrm{m} 不是阻力 D / Not drag force. 双缝间距 / double-slit separation s \mathrm{m} 不是位移 s / Not displacement in this context. 光栅缝距 / grating spacing d \mathrm{m} 相邻透光缝的间距 / Adjacent-slit separation. 衍射级次 / diffraction order n 1 （无量纲 / dimensionless） 整数；与折射率 n 区分 / An integer, not refractive index. 角、转角 / angle \theta \mathrm{rad} 角度须按题设使用；运动学角变量用 rad / Follow stated angle units; use radians in angular kinematics. <!-- QUANTITY_SYMBOLS_20261021_END -- 方法、分析与误差 / Method, analysis and uncertainty 1 使用单色激光，保持缝或光栅稳定对准、图样清晰。 Use monochromatic laser light, stable slit/grating alignment and a clearly visible pattern. 2 双缝测多条纹间隔、屏距与缝距，求波长。 For double slits, measure many fringe intervals, screen distance and slit separation; calculate λ=ws/D. 3 光栅由刻线数求缝距，测已知级次角度，用光栅方程并比较两侧。 For a grating, convert line density to d, measure θ for a known order, use d sinθ=nλ and compare both sides. 4 重复测量并按测量量合成相对不确定度。 Use repeat measurements and percentage uncertainty combinations appropriate to the measured quantities. 5 避免直视光束及镜面反射，光束高度避开眼睛。 Avoid direct laser viewing and specular reflections; keep beam height away from eye level. 自检 / Retrieval - [ ] 画出装置并标出测量量 / Draw and label the apparatus. - [ ] 写出控制变量与数据表列 / State controls and data-table columns. - [ ] 解释图像斜率、截距及不确定度 / Interpret gradients, intercepts and uncertainty. 考纲依据 / Specification： 必做实验 5，3.5.6、3.5.7；教材相关页见对应知识节点。 定量分析与条件核对 / Quantitative analysis and controls A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.6 干涉、相干与杨氏双缝 - Interference 必做实验5及安全 / Required practical 5 and safety 光栅部分 / Grating analysis： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.7 单缝衍射与光栅 - Diffraction 光栅方程的几何推导 / Deriving the grating equation

Follow any explicit value separately specified in the question. 如何使用评分例证 / How to use the evidence - 物理原则 / Physical principle： 各题都应保持物理量、关系、条件和方向正确。 / Keep quantities, relationships, conditions and directions physically correct. - 推荐书写 / Presentation advice： 用于让推理清楚可查，不自动等于独立评分点。 / Makes reasoning visible; not every recommendation is a separate mark. - 本题明确要求 / Question-specific requirement： 标注试卷、题号和评分标准 PDF 页；仅用于所引题目。 / Paper, question and MS PDF page identify the exact restriction. - 点击“原题与答案”可进入既有题目页，答案仍在题下默认折叠。点击 MS 链接可核对原评分页。 / Open the original practice note for its collapsed answer, or the MS page for the rubric. 自检顺序 / Review order： 题问与指令词 → 模型及条件 → 计算或图示 → 物理解释 → 单位、精度及数据沿用。 / Task → model and conditions → calculation or diagram → explanation → units, precision and carried answers.

text: 电荷流与电流 / Charge and current 关键词 → 模型 / Keywords → model electrons → charge → current → time → 电荷流与电流 推理顺序 / Reasoning 先由电子数求电荷，再除以时间；传统电流与电子运动方向相反。 Count charge using Q=ne ; divide by the time interval; state conventional current opposite to electron motion. 知识与条件 / Knowledge and conditions 3.4.1 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.4 电学/3.4.1 电学基础 - Basics of electricity 3.4.1 电学基础 时间间隔内使用平均电流；瞬时电流为电荷—时间图像的切线斜率。 Use average current over an interval; instantaneous current is the gradient of a charge–time graph. 单位分别为安培、库仑、伏特和欧姆；一伏特为一焦耳每库仑。 I=\Delta Q/\Delta t ; V=W/Q ; R=V/I . Units: A, C, V and \Omega . text: 伏安特性与工作点 / Characteristic and operating point 关键词 → 模型 / Keywords → model characteristic → filament lamp → diode → operating point → 伏安特性与工作点 推理顺序 / Reasoning 识别坐标轴，读工作点，求电阻和功率，再解释温度导致的阻值变化。 Identify the axes; read the stated operating point; find R=V/I and P=VI ; explain any temperature-dependent resistance change. 知识与条件 / Knowledge and conditions 3.4.2 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.4 电学/3.4.2 伏安特性与欧姆定律 - Current–voltage characteristics 3.4.2 伏安特性与欧姆定律 欧姆定律要求温度等物理条件不变。未另作说明时，电流表电阻为零，电压表电阻无限大。 Ohm’s law: current is directly proportional to potential difference provided temperature and other physical conditions remain constant. Ideal ammeters have zero resistance; ideal voltmeters have infinite resistance unless stated otherwise. 工作点的电阻使用电压与电流之比；直线图像的斜率含义取决于坐标轴。 R=V/I at an operating point. On a straight V – I graph, gradient =R ; on a straight I – V graph, gradient =1/R . 3.4.4 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.4 电学/3.4.4 直流电路与电功率 - Circuits 3.4.4 直流电路与电功率 恒定电压和电流时使用电能公式；功率公式中的电流、电压和电阻必须对应同一元件。 Apply E=IVt when voltage and current are constant. I^2R and V^2/R refer to the voltage/current of the same resistor. 掌握串并联等效电阻、电能和功率。 R_{\mathrm{s}}=R_1+R_2+\cdots ; 1/R_{\mathrm{p}}=1/R_1+1/R_2+\cdots ; E=IVt ; P=IV=I^2R=V^2/R . 真题复述 / Past-paper retrieval - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q13 题目 202606-Q13 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q14 题目 202606-Q14 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q23 题目 202606-Q23 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving.

text: 电源内阻与图像截距 / EMF and internal resistance 关键词 → 模型 / Keywords → model emf → terminal pd → internal resistance → gradient → 电源内阻与图像截距 推理顺序 / Reasoning 用路端电压式；截距求电动势、负斜率求内阻；总电流越大内损越大。 Use V=\varepsilon-Ir ; a voltage–current line gives emf at the intercept and resistance from the negative gradient; increasing load current increases internal loss. 知识与条件 / Knowledge and conditions 3.4.6 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.4 电学/3.4.6 电动势与内阻 - Electromotive force and internal resistance 3.4.6 电动势与内阻 以上符号用于电源放电供电；开路时路端电势差等于电动势；内阻电流为总电流。 These signs refer to a source supplying current. On open circuit, I=0 and V=\varepsilon . Use the total current through the source, not a branch current. 电动势分配为路端电势差和内电势降。 \varepsilon=E/Q=I(R+r) ; V=\varepsilon-Ir ; I=\varepsilon/(R+r) ; lost volts =Ir ; internal power loss =I^2r . 真题复述 / Past-paper retrieval - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q08 题目 202606-Q08 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q11 题目 202606-Q11 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q14 题目 202606-Q14 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving.

title: 弹簧振子与单摆实验 / Pendulum and mass-spring
folder: A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/07 常用物理模型
text: 弹簧振子与单摆实验 / Pendulum and mass-spring 关键词 → 模型 / Keywords → model pendulum → mass-spring → period → timing → 弹簧振子与单摆实验 推理顺序 / Reasoning 选周期关系，多周期计时，作周期平方图，用斜率和控制变量求参数。 Choose the correct oscillator period relation; measure many cycles; plot T^2 against mass or length; use the gradient and controlled variables. 知识与条件 / Knowledge and conditions 3.5.1 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.1 振动系统、能量与阻尼 - Oscillating systems 3.5.1 振动系统、能量与阻尼 弹簧近似轻且满足胡克定律、阻尼可忽略；单摆需小角度、轻绳和近似质点摆球；摆长为支点至球心距离。 Use a light Hookean spring and negligible damping for the spring formula; use a small-angle pendulum, light string and concentrated bob for the pendulum formula. Length is pivot to the centre of the bob. 掌握弹簧振子、单摆周期与频率关系。 T=2\pi\sqrt{m/k} for a mass–spring system; T=2\pi\sqrt{l/g} for a simple pendulum; f=1/T . 真题复述 / Past-paper retrieval - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q07 题目 202606-Q07 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q15 题目 202606-Q15 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q16 题目 202606-Q16 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving.

source: A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/07 常用物理模型/U2PM08 共振峰与阻尼 - Resonance and damping.md
title: 共振峰与阻尼 / Resonance and damping
folder: A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/07 常用物理模型
text: 共振峰与阻尼 / Resonance and damping 关键词 → 模型 / Keywords → model driving frequency → natural frequency → resonance → damping → 共振峰与阻尼 推理顺序 / Reasoning 比较驱动与固有频率，说明能量传递，再由阻尼判断峰值高低和宽度。 Compare driving and natural frequencies; explain energy transfer; use damping to predict peak height and width. 知识与条件 / Knowledge and conditions 3.5.2 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.2 受迫振动与共振 - Forced vibrations and resonance 3.5.2 受迫振动与共振 U2 对共振采用定性处理；稳定受迫振动的频率由驱动源决定。 Treat resonance qualitatively in U2. In steady forced vibration, oscillation frequency is set by the driver. 轻阻尼时共振频率接近固有频率；不要求共振曲线定量方程。 For lightly damped systems, the resonance frequency is close to the natural frequency. No quantitative resonance-curve equation is required. 真题复述 / Past-paper retrieval - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/201801/PH02 201801 Q23 题目 201801-Q23 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202401/PH02 202401 Q10 题目 202401-Q10 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202406/PH02 202406 Q07 题目 202406-Q07 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving.

source: A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/07 常用物理模型/U2PM09 行波相位与回波计时 - Phase and echo.md
title: 行波相位与回波计时 / Phase and echo
folder: A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/07 常用物理模型
text: 行波相位与回波计时 / Phase and echo 关键词 → 模型 / Keywords → model phase → wavelength → echo → ultrasound → 行波相位与回波计时 推理顺序 / Reasoning 区分时间图和距离图，把相位换成周期分数；回波往返路程需除二。 Distinguish time and distance graphs; express phase as a cycle fraction; for an echo divide the total travel distance by two. 知识与条件 / Knowledge and conditions 3.5.3 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.3 行波、相位与波参数 - Progressive waves 3.5.3 行波、相位与波参数 空间相位关系用于同一行波的不同位置；时间相位关系比较固定位置的周期阶段。 Spatial phase formula applies to points on the same progressive wave; time separation compares equivalent cycles at a fixed point. 相位差可用弧度、角度或周期分数表示。 c=f\lambda ; f=1/T ; \Delta\phi=2\pi\Delta x/\lambda=2\pi\Delta t/T in radians, or 360^\circ\Delta x/\lambda . 3.5.4 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.4 横波、纵波、偏振与超声 - Longitudinal and transverse waves 3.5.4 横波、纵波、偏振与超声 不要求马吕斯定律；所有电磁波在真空中速率相同，电场和磁场的振动为横向。 Malus’s law is not required. All electromagnetic waves have the same speed in vacuum; their electric and magnetic fields oscillate transversely. 往返超声时间对应的深度须除以二。 Echo distance d=ct/2 for a pulse travelling to an interface and back. 真题复述 / Past-paper retrieval - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q18 题目 202606-Q18 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q20 题目 202606-Q20 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q21 题目 202606-Q21 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving.

title: 弦驻波与谐波 / Node and harmonic
folder: A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/07 常用物理模型
text: 弦驻波与谐波 / Node and harmonic 关键词 → 模型 / Keywords → model node → antinode → harmonic → tension → 弦驻波与谐波 推理顺序 / Reasoning 看端点条件、数波腹，求波长，再用张力与线密度关系，说明反射与叠加。 Inspect end conditions and count loops; find wavelength; use the tension and linear-density relation; explain reflection and superposition. 知识与条件 / Knowledge and conditions 3.5.5 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.5 叠加原理、驻波与谐波 - Superposition and stationary waves 3.5.5 叠加原理、驻波与谐波 标准完整波节图要求反向波同频、等振幅；弦需均匀且两端固定。采用“第一谐波”和“谐波”术语。 For the standard complete-node pattern, the counter-propagating waves have equal frequency and equal amplitude. String relationships assume uniform linear density and both ends fixed. Use “first harmonic” and “harmonics”. 弦张力用 F 表示，避免与周期 T 混淆；两端固定弦的第 n 谐波含 n 个波腹。 f_1=\frac{1}{2L}\sqrt{F/\mu} ; \mu=m/L ; \lambda_n=2L/n and f_n=nf_1 for a string fixed at both ends. 真题复述 / Past-paper retrieval - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q17 题目 202606-Q17 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q18 题目 202606-Q18 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q19 题目 202606-Q19 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving.

title: 程差与干涉条纹 / Path difference and fringe
folder: A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/07 常用物理模型
text: 程差与干涉条纹 / Path difference and fringe 关键词 → 模型 / Keywords → model coherent → path difference → double slit → fringe → 程差与干涉条纹 推理顺序 / Reasoning 先确认相干，再比较程差与波长；双缝计算注意条纹间隔数量。 Check coherence; compare path difference with wavelength; for a double slit use fringe separation with correct interval counting. 知识与条件 / Knowledge and conditions 3.5.6 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.6 干涉、相干与杨氏双缝 - Interference 3.5.6 干涉、相干与杨氏双缝 条纹间距近似需屏距远大于缝距且角度小；完全相消还需振幅相等；相干不要求相位差为零。 The fringe-spacing approximation requires D\gg s and small angles. Complete cancellation additionally requires equal amplitudes. Coherence does not require zero phase difference. 同相源增强与相消分别对应整波长和奇数半波长程差；双缝条纹间距与波长、屏距成正比，与缝距成反比。 For in-phase sources: constructive \Delta x=n\lambda , destructive \Delta x=(n+\tfrac12)\lambda . Double-slit fringe spacing w=\lambda D/s . 真题复述 / Past-paper retrieval - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202601/PH02 202601 Q20 题目 202601-Q20 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q10 题目 202606-Q10 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q22 题目 202606-Q22 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving.

source: A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/07 常用物理模型/U2PM12 光栅级次与波长 - Grating and order.md
title: 光栅级次与波长 / Grating and order
folder: A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/07 常用物理模型
text: 光栅级次与波长 / Grating and order 关键词 → 模型 / Keywords → model grating → order → lines per mm → angle → 光栅级次与波长 推理顺序 / Reasoning 把刻线密度换缝距，由程差推方程，并检查允许级次。 Convert line density to slit spacing; derive path difference; apply the grating equation and the allowed sine range. 知识与条件 / Knowledge and conditions 3.5.7 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.7 单缝衍射与光栅 - Diffraction 3.5.7 单缝衍射与光栅 光栅方程用于平面透射光栅、正入射；不要求分光计操作或单缝强度—角度曲线。 Use the grating equation for a plane transmission grating at normal incidence. A spectrometer’s operation and a single-slit intensity-versus-angle graph are not required. 缝距为每米刻线数的倒数；最大级次受正弦不超过一限制。 d\sin\theta=n\lambda ; d=1/(\text{lines per metre}) ; permitted orders satisfy n\lambda/d\leq1 . 真题复述 / Past-paper retrieval - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202601/PH02 202601 Q19 题目 202601-Q19 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202601/PH02 202601 Q21 题目 202601-Q21 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q04 题目 202606-Q04 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving.

title: 折射与全反射光纤 / Critical angle and fibre
folder: A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/07 常用物理模型
text: 折射与全反射光纤 / Critical angle and fibre 关键词 → 模型 / Keywords → model normal → critical angle → core → cladding → dispersion → 折射与全反射光纤 推理顺序 / Reasoning 角度从法线量，应用折射定律并检查两个全反射条件；区分脉冲展宽与强度损耗。 Measure angles to the normal; apply Snell’s law; check both total-reflection conditions; distinguish pulse broadening from intensity loss. 知识与条件 / Knowledge and conditions 3.5.8 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.8 折射、全反射与光纤 - Refraction at a plane surface 3.5.8 折射、全反射与光纤 全反射需从高折射率向低折射率传播且入射角大于临界角；光纤限阶跃型。 Total internal reflection needs both high-to-low refractive index propagation and incidence above the critical angle. Fibres are limited to step-index types. 空气折射率近似为一；角度均从法线量起。 n=c/c_{\mathrm{s}} ; n_1\sin\theta_1=n_2\sin\theta_2 ; \sin\theta_c=n_2/n_1 for n_1 n_2 . 真题复述 / Past-paper retrieval - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202506/PH02 202506 Q23 题目 202506-Q23 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202601/PH02 202601 Q04 题目 202601-Q04 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q09 题目 202606-Q09 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving.

source: A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/07 常用物理模型/U2PM14 离散能级与光谱 - Excitation and transition.md
title: 离散能级与光谱 / Excitation and transition
folder: A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/07 常用物理模型
text: 离散能级与光谱 / Excitation and transition 关键词 → 模型 / Keywords → model excitation → ionisation → transition → spectrum → 离散能级与光谱 推理顺序 / Reasoning 区分激发与移除电子，求能级差、换单位，判断发射吸收与X射线机制。 Distinguish excitation from removal; subtract level energies; convert eV to J; identify photon emission or absorption and X-ray mechanisms. 知识与条件 / Knowledge and conditions 3.5.9 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.9 原子能级、线谱与X射线 - Collisions of electrons with atoms 3.5.9 原子能级、线谱与X射线 光子吸收需能量匹配允许能级差；入射电子可只转移激发所需部分能量；使用 SI 制普朗克常量前把电子伏特换成焦耳。 For photon absorption, photon energy must match the allowed energy gap. An incident electron can transfer the required excitation energy and retain the remainder. Convert eV to J before using SI Planck constant. 电子伏特是能量单位；发射光子的能量为上下能级差，X射线最高光子能量受加速电压限制。 1\,\mathrm{eV}=1.602\times10^{-19}\,\mathrm{J} ; emitted photon hf=E_{\mathrm{upper}}-E_{\mathrm{lower}} ; electron accelerated through V gains eV ; X-ray maximum photon energy =eV . 真题复述 / Past-paper retrieval - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202601/PH02 202601 Q23 题目 202601-Q23 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q23 题目 202606-Q23 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving. - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH02 202606 Q24 题目 202606-Q24 — 先说模型和适用条件，再独立作答 / identify the model and conditions before solving.

source: A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/07 常用物理模型/U2PM15 光电效应强度与频率 - Threshold and work function.md
title: 光电效应强度与频率 / Threshold and work function

text: 光电效应强度与频率 / Threshold and work function 关键词 → 模型 / Keywords → model threshold → work function → intensity → stopping potential → 光电效应强度与频率 推理顺序 / Reasoning 比较光子能量与逸出功，区分单光子能量和光子到达率，再求最大动能。 Compare photon energy with work function; separate energy per photon from photon arrival rate; use the maximum kinetic energy relation. 知识与条件 / Knowledge and conditions 3.5.10 A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U2/02 知识节点/3.5 振动与波/3.5.10 光子与光电效应 - Photoelectric effect 3.5.10 光子与光电效应 不要求遏止电势的实验测定；比较强度作用时需固定高于截止频率的频率。 The experimental determination of stopping potential is not required. Concept / 概念 - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/02 知识节点/概念与定义/3.6.1 角速率 angular speed angular speed — 角速率 - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/02 知识节点/概念与定义/3.6.1 向心加速度 centripetal acceleration centripetal acceleration — 向心加速度 - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/02 知识节点/概念与定义/3.6.1 向心力 centripetal force centripetal force — 向心力 Definition / 定义 Physics diagram Physics diagram Physics diagram 定义按考纲与指定教材概括；本页未列出可直接对应的定义题评分条目。 Definitions are summarised from the specification and textbook; no directly matched definition-item citation is claimed here. Formula / 公式与单位 角速率使用弧度每秒；向心力为合力的径向分量。 \omega=v/r=2\pi f=2\pi/T ; a_c=v^2/r=r\omega^2 ; F_c=mv^2/r=mr\omega^2 . Units: rad s ^{-1} , m s ^{-2} , N. Conditions / 条件与范围 考纲核心为匀速圆周运动。 a_r=v^2/r 和 \sum F_r=mv^2/r 也适用于固定半径变速圆周运动的瞬时径向分量；此时另有可能的切向加速度。整周 2\pi/T 与 2\pi r/T 作为任一点的角速率、线速率需匀速。不考向心加速度公式的推导。 The core assessed case is uniform circular motion. The radial acceleration and force equations also apply instantaneously at varying speed, when tangential acceleration may exist. Circumference or full angle divided by period gives instantaneous speed only for uniform motion. The centripetal-acceleration derivation is excluded. Explanation / 解释 角量、线量与向心加速度 / Angular and linear quantities 匀速圆周运动的速率不变，但速度方向不断改变，故存在加速度。任一点的速度沿切线，向心加速度和径向合力指向圆心；“向心力”是实际力的径向合力，不是在重力、张力之外另加的力。 Uniform circular motion has constant speed but changing velocity. Velocity is tangential; centripetal acceleration and the radial resultant point towards the centre. Centripetal force is supplied by real forces, not an extra force. s=r\theta ， v=r\omega ，匀速时 \omega=2\pi/T=2\pi f ， a_r=v^2/r=\omega^2r ， \sum F_{\rm inward}=mv^2/r 。角量使用弧度，转每分钟先除以60得到 Hz。 Use radians in angular equations. Convert revolutions per minute to hertz before calculating angular speed. 径向关系 a_r=v^2/r 在变速圆周运动的每一位置也成立，但此时还可有切向加速度，合加速度不一定纯向心； v=2\pi r/T 给出一周平均速率，仅匀速时也是任一点速率。本考纲不考 a_r=v^2/r 的推导。 The radial relation also applies instantaneously when speed varies, but tangential acceleration may then exist. Circumference divided by period is the mean speed for a full revolution; it equals instantaneous speed only in uniform motion. The centripetal-acceleration derivation is excluded. 受力情境分类与作答流程 / Force scenarios and method 先定位圆心、画真实受力，再把向心方向定为正并投影列 \sum F_r=mv^2/r ；垂直于圆周平面的方向若无加速度，应另列平衡。最后检查绳是否拉紧、物体是否接触、摩擦是否足够。 Locate the centre, draw real forces and resolve towards the centre. Apply equilibrium separately in directions with zero acceleration. Check tension, contact and friction constraints. 水平绳、圆锥摆、平路转弯、倾斜弯道由不同实际力提供径向合力；拱桥与凹路、竖直绳和游乐装置需根据所在位置重新判定重力方向。下方的模型分类给出独立受力方程。 Different forces supply radial resultants in horizontal strings, conical pendulums, level turns and banked bends. At road crests, dips and vertical rides, re-evaluate weight's radial direction at each position. 变速竖直运动先用机械能关系求局部速率，再列径向方程；临界时可令张力或支持力为零。各模型是考纲向心力公式与已有力学知识的应用，不新增一套无条件背诵公式。 For varying-speed vertical motion, use energy to obtain local speed, then apply the radial force equation. Critical cases may have zero tension or normal reaction. Applications / 应用与实验 画真实受力并沿向心方向列式；竖直圆周情况需考虑重力和该处速率，速率变化时结合能量守恒。 Draw a force diagram and sum real forces towards the centre. For vertical circular situations, include weight and use the speed at the stated position; use energy conservation when speed changes. Common errors / 易错点 真实受力已列全后，不再额外添加向心力；角速率恒定不等于速度恒定。 Do not add an extra “centripetal force” to a diagram already containing all real forces. Constant angular speed is not constant velocity. 真题检验与答题思路 / Exam coverage and approaches 依据本库现有真题与评分标准核对。下列步骤按题型使用，先核对题设条件；综合题需结合其他关联知识点。 / Checked against the papers and mark schemes held in this vault; select the approach that fits the stated conditions. 3.6.1 方法 1 · 真实受力、约束与临界值 / Forces, constraints and limiting motion 1. 确定圆心与 实际轨道半径 ，画重力、张力、支持力、摩擦力；向心力是这些力的径向合力，不另画一个附加力。 / Identify the centre and actual radius; centripetal force is the radial resultant. 2. 竖直方向平衡与径向方程分开。圆锥摆若角度从竖直量， T\cos\theta=mg 、 T\sin\theta=m\omega^2r ；若从水平量则互换正余弦。支点偏离轴时 r=D+l\sin\theta 。 / Resolve using the angle actually defined in the diagram. 3. 水平转弯、转盘由静摩擦提供径向力；临界打滑才令 f=f_{max} 。倾斜弯道由支持力和摩擦的 水平分量 共同提供径向合力。 / Use maximum friction only at the stated limit. 4. 竖直圆周顶端临界接触时支持力为零，底部通常 T-mg=mv^2/r Formula / 公式与单位 a=-\omega^2x ； \omega=2\pi f=2\pi/T ； x=A\cos(\omega t+\phi) ； v=-\omega A\sin(\omega t+\phi) ； v=\pm\omega\sqrt{A^2-x^2} 。 v_{\max}=\omega A ， a _{\max}=\omega^2A ； E_p=\tfrac12m\omega^2x^2 ， E_k=\tfrac12m\omega^2(A^2-x^2) ， E_{\rm total}=\tfrac12m\omega^2A^2 。 速度符号由运动方向决定，振动势能以平衡位置为零，无阻尼时总能量恒定。 Choose the velocity sign from direction of motion. Effective oscillator potential energy is zero at equilibrium; total energy is constant without damping. Conditions / 条件与范围 理想简谐运动要求线性回复力且阻尼可忽略；单摆采用小角度近似。 For ideal SHM use a linear restoring force and negligible damping. For a simple pendulum, use small angles so \sin\theta\approx\theta . Explanation / 解释 简谐判定、方程与相位 / SHM condition and phase 从平衡位置量有符号位移 x ，恢复加速度满足 a=-\omega^2x ：大小与位移成正比，方向总指向平衡位置。 ω 在该理想系统中为常量；仅仅“往复”不足以判定简谐。 SHM requires acceleration proportional to displacement from equilibrium and directed towards equilibrium, with constant angular frequency. Repeated back-and-forth motion alone is insufficient. 若从正向最大位移静止释放，可用 x=A\cos\omega t 、 v=-A\omega\sin\omega t 、 a=-\omega^2A\cos\omega t 。其他初始状态应调整相位，不能强行把所有运动都写成无初相余弦。 v=\pm\omega\sqrt{A^2-x^2} 的符号由运动方向决定。 The zero-phase cosine solution assumes release from positive maximum displacement. Other initial conditions require a phase shift. Choose the sign of velocity from the direction of travel. 图像、极值和能量 / Graphs, extrema and energy v 是 x – t 的斜率， a 是 v – t 的斜率。 a 与 x 反相； x 与 v 相差四分之一周期。平衡处 v _{\max}=\omega A 、 a=0 ；端点 v=0 、 a _{\max}=\omega^2A 。 Velocity and acceleration are gradients of the corresponding time graphs. Acceleration is in antiphase with displacement; velocity is a quarter-cycle out of phase. Speed peaks at equilibrium and acceleration magnitude at the extremes. 以平衡位置的有效振动势能为零： E_p=\tfrac12m\omega^2x^2 ， E_k=\tfrac12m\omega^2(A^2-x^2) ， E_{\rm total}=\tfrac12m\omega^2A^2 。能量随时间以振动频率的两倍变化，总能量在无阻尼时恒定；振幅加倍使能量变为四倍。 Effective oscillator potential energy is quadratic in displacement; kinetic energy is the complementary parabola. The energy variations have twice the oscillation frequency, while total energy is constant without damping. 周期推导与成立条件 / Period derivations 弹簧： F=-kx=ma ，与 a=-\omega^2x 比较得 \omega^2=k/m ，所以 T=2\pi\sqrt{m/k} 。竖直弹簧应先用 kx_0=mg 消去静态平衡项，再对平衡位置附近的额外位移列式。 For a spring, compare ma=-kx with the SHM condition. For a vertical spring, first remove the static equilibrium extension before identifying the restoring force. 单摆：沿圆弧 s=l\theta ，切向 ma_t=-mg\sin\theta 。小角度下 \sin\theta\approx\theta=s/l ，故 a_t=-(g/l)s ，得到 T=2\pi\sqrt{l/g} 。弧度、小角度、轻且不可伸长摆线是必要条件。 For a pendulum, use the tangential component of weight and \sin\theta\approx\theta=s/l at small angles. This gives SHM with \omega^2=g/l . The approximation uses radians and a light inextensible string. 逐项覆盖 / Requirement-by-requirement coverage： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/01 考纲框架/00 U3知识覆盖核对 - Syllabus coverage audit 3.6.2 简谐运动 / SIMPLE HARMONIC MOTION 3.6.2 原课件图像 / Source diagrams [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram 图像按原课件来源保留，解释与公式以本页考纲范围为准。 Original teaching images are retained; the text and conditions above define the assessed scope. U3 SHM graphs Physics diagram 简谐运动位移、速度、加速度相位及状态图；速度有正负两个分支。 Normalised SHM graphs. Applications / 应用与实验 由初始位置与速度选相位；掌握周期推导。 Choose phase from the initial position and velocity; derive period expressions rather than memorising unexplained equations. Common errors / 易错点 端点加速度最大但速度零；平衡处加速度零而速率最大。 Maximum acceleration occurs at the extreme position, where velocity is zero. At equilibrium, acceleration is zero and speed is maximum. 真题检验与答题思路 / Exam coverage and approaches 依据本库现有真题与评分标准核对。下列步骤按题型使用，先核对题设条件；综合题需结合其他关联知识点。 / Checked against the papers and mark schemes held in this vault; select the approach that fits the stated conditions. 3.6.2 方法 1 · 简谐条件与失效判断 / Testing and rejecting SHM 规范表述 / Standard statement: Acceleration is directly proportional to displacement from equilibrium and is directed towards equilibrium. / 加速度与相对平衡位置的位移成正比，方向指向平衡位置。 1. 先写合力，不把单独的弹簧力误作合力。竖直弹簧以静态平衡为原点，可得 F_{net}=-kx ， \omega^2=k/m 。 / Use the resultant force and the equilibrium origin. 2. a – x 图须为过原点的负斜率直线；斜率为 -\omega^2 ，故 f=\sqrt{-m_{graph}}/(2\pi) 。 / Use both proportionality and direction. 3. 弹性绳松弛后，张力为零而合力为重力，加速度恒定为 g ，不再满足 a\propto-x 。库仑力始终指向中心也不保证其大小与位移成正比。 / A restoring direction alone is insufficient. 4. 外界阻力问题根据是否显著破坏上述比例作判断，并给出题境中的理由；不要只说“有阻力所以一定不是”。 / Explain how the actual extra force affects the SHM condition. 对应真题 / Examples： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/06 真题练习/按试卷/202001/PH03 202001 Q01 题目 PH03 · 202001 · Q01 ； A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/06 真题练习/按试卷/202301/PH03 202301 Q02 题目 PH03 · 202301 · Q02 ； A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/06 真题练习/按试卷/202201/PH03 202201 Q01 题目 PH03 · 202201 · Q01 ； A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/06 真题练习/按试卷/202206/PH03 202206 Q04 题目 PH03 · 202206 · Q04 ； A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/06 真题练习/按试卷/202606/PH03 202606 Q03 题目 PH03 · 202606 · Q03 。 3.6.2 方法 2 · 位移、时间与能量图像 / Displacement, timing and energy graphs 1. x=A\cos(\omega t+\phi) ，用初始位置和运动方向确定相位；求首次到达或返回某位置，画一周期并选 满足方向的最小正时间差 ，不能只取反余弦的主值。 / Select the physical branch, not merely the inverse-trigonometric value. 2. v=\pm\omega\sqrt{A^2-x^2} 的正负由运动方向决定； a=-\omega^2x 的方向由位移决定。 v 与 x 相差 \pi/2 ， a 与 x 相差 \pi 。 / Motion direction and acceleration direction are different decisions. 3. Concept / 概念 - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/02 知识节点/概念与定义/3.7.1 引力 gravitational force gravitational force — 引力 - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/02 知识节点/概念与定义/3.7.1 万有引力常量 gravitational constant gravitational constant — 万有引力常量 Definition / 定义 Physics diagram Physics diagram 定义按考纲与指定教材概括；本页未列出可直接对应的定义题评分条目。 Definitions are summarised from the specification and textbook; no directly matched definition-item citation is claimed here. Formula / 公式与单位 距离为两质量中心间距。 F=Gm_1m_2/r^2 , with G in N m ^2 kg ^{-2} . Conditions / 条件与范围 采用质点或球对称物体外部模型；距离为中心间距而非距表面高度。 Treat masses as point masses, or use spherically symmetric bodies viewed from outside. Use centre-to-centre separation, not height above the surface. Explanation / 解释 万有引力的方向与适用对象 / Direction and source masses F=Gm_1m_2/r^2 是两个点质量的引力大小，总为相互吸引，沿两者连线；两力大小相等、方向相反，分别作用在不同物体上。 G 是普适常量， g 是随位置变化的场强。 Gravitation between point masses is attractive along their line of centres. The action–reaction pair acts on different bodies. Distinguish universal constant G from local field strength g . 球对称天体外部可把其质量视为集中在球心； r 是中心距，卫星高度 h 应先转为 r=R+h 。不能将外部平方反比公式直接用于天体内部。 Outside a spherically symmetric body, use its mass at its centre. Radius is centre-to-centre distance, not height above the surface; the external inverse-square expression cannot automatically be extended inside. 比例、叠加与联系 / Scaling and superposition 质量不变时，距离加倍使引力为四分之一；多个天体的作用力须作矢量和。引力不需要接触或介质；引力提供卫星圆轨道所需的向心合力。 Doubling separation quarters the force. Add forces from several bodies as vectors. Formula / 公式与单位 星球表面以上需将半径与高度相加；场强为矢量。 g=F/m ; radial magnitude g=GM/r^2 ; r=R+h above a spherical planet. Units: N kg ^{-1} , equivalent to m s ^{-2} . Conditions / 条件与范围 径向公式用于球体外部；表面附近小高度范围可近似匀强。 The radial formula applies outside a spherical body. Near a planet’s surface over small heights, the field can be approximated as uniform. Explanation / 解释 场线与局部场强 / Field lines and local strength 引力场是质量会受到引力作用的区域， \vec g=\vec F/m ，单位 \mathrm{N\,kg^{-1}} ，等价于 \mathrm{m\,s^{-2}} 。试探质量受力越大不表示原场更强；比较时要除以质量。 A gravitational field is a region where a mass experiences gravitational force. Field strength is force per unit mass and also equals free-fall acceleration at that position. 场线切线给 \vec g 的方向，疏密表示相对强弱，场线不相交。球对称天体外部为指向中心的径向场， g=GM/r^2 （大小）；近地小区域可近似为平行等距的匀强场。 Field-line tangents give direction and line density indicates relative strength. Lines never cross. Outside a spherical source the field is radial and inward; a small region near Earth's surface is approximately uniform. 高度、叠加与引力势 / Height, superposition and potential 随高度增加 g 减小，计算用 r=R+h 。多个天体的场强是矢量和，沿一直线时先定正方向；两天体之间可能存在合场强为零的点，但该处引力势不必为零。 Field strength decreases with altitude. Superpose fields as vectors; between two bodies the resultant field can be zero while the potential is nonzero. g – r 的外部大小曲线按 1/r^2 衰减；不能把地表 g 当作所有高度的常量。 Outside the source, field magnitude falls as 1/r^2 ; surface gravity is not constant at arbitrary altitude. 逐项覆盖 / Requirement-by-requirement coverage： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/01 考纲框架/00 U3知识覆盖核对 - Syllabus coverage audit 3.7.2 引力场强 / GRAVITATIONAL FIELD STRENGTH 3.7.2 原课件图像 / Source diagrams [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram 图像按原课件来源保留，解释与公式以本页考纲范围为准。 Original teaching images are retained; the text and conditions above define the assessed scope. Applications / 应用与实验 能分辨场强随距离的反平方曲线和势随距离的反比曲线。 Read a g – r graph and distinguish its inverse-square shape from the potential’s inverse-distance shape. Common errors / 易错点 零场强不等于零引力势；自由落体并非没有重力。 A point of zero field does not imply zero gravitational potential. Formula / 公式与单位 无穷远规定为零势，吸引质量的引力势为负。 V=-GM/r ; U=mV=-GMm/r ; \Delta U=m\Delta V ; radial signed g_r=-dV/dr . Conditions / 条件与范围 缓慢移动或动能不变时，外力功等于势能变化；引力功符号相反。 An external-work value equals potential energy change for a slow transfer or unchanged kinetic energy; work done by gravity has the opposite sign. Explanation / 解释 势、势能和正负号 / Potential, energy and signs 引力势是将单位质量从无穷远缓慢移到该点时外力所做的功，无穷远势为零。 V=-GM/r ， E_p=mV=-GMm/r ；引力吸引质量，因此有限距离的势为负，向远处移动时势增大并趋近零。 Gravitational potential is external work per unit mass in bringing a mass slowly from infinity. With zero at infinity, V=-GM/r and potential energy is mV ; both rise towards zero on moving outward. \Delta E_p=m(V_2-V_1) ；缓慢移动时外力做功等于该变化，引力做功则为 -\Delta E_p 。仅在近地小高度且 g 可视为恒定时使用 \Delta E_p=mg\Delta h 。 External work in a slow transfer equals the increase in potential energy; gravitational work has the opposite sign. Use mg\Delta h only where gravity is approximately uniform. 等势面上 \Delta V=0 ，沿面移动时引力不做功；径向场等势面是同心球面，与场线垂直。 No gravitational work is done along an equipotential surface. Radial-field equipotentials are concentric spheres perpendicular to field lines. 图像斜率与面积 / Gradients and areas 取径向向外为正， g_r=-dV/dr=-GM/r^2 ；场强大小 g=GM/r^2 。 V – r 在负值区随 r 增大趋近零，切线斜率为正，其负值是有符号场分量。 With outward radius positive, the radial field is the negative potential gradient. The potential curve rises from negative values towards zero; its positive slope gives an inward field after the minus sign. V_2-V_1=-\int_{r_1}^{r_2}g_r\,dr ；已知图上画的是“场强大小”还是“有符号分量”后再处理面积。考纲原文个别大小写不改变 \Delta E_p=m\Delta V 的物理含义。 Potential difference is the negative signed field area. Check whether a graph shows field magnitude or signed component before interpreting its area. 逐项覆盖 / Requirement-by-requirement coverage： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/01 考纲框架/00 U3知识覆盖核对 - Syllabus coverage audit 3.7.3 引力势 / GRAVITATIONAL POTENTIAL 3.7.3 原课件图像 / Source diagrams [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram 图像按原课件来源保留，解释与公式以本页考纲范围为准。 Original teaching images are retained; the text and conditions above define the assessed scope. U3 Gravitational field potential Physics diagram 球体外部场强大小按反平方下降，势为负并趋近零；势的负斜率给出带符号径向场强。 Exterior spherical field. Applications / 应用与实验 大范围提升卫星时用引力势差，近似匀强场才使用重力势能变化公式。 Calculate the work needed to raise a satellite over a large distance; use mg\Delta h only for an approximately uniform field. Common errors / 易错点 绝对势须说明无穷远零势；不可删去引力势负号。 “Zero at infinity” is essential to the absolute potential convention; do not drop the negative sign from gravitational potential. 真题检验与答题思路 / Exam coverage 引力势、能量账目与势垒 / Potential, energy budgets and barriers 定义细节 / Definition detail. 势是把小测试质量从无穷远移至该点的外力功除以质量；以无穷远为零，引力吸引使有限距离处的势为负。 / Gravitational potential is external work per unit mass from infinity to the point, with zero at infinity. 1. 用 E_{p,f}-E_{p,i}=m(V_f-V_i) ；沿长距离不能默认 g 恒定而用 mgh 。由能量求出中心距后再减天体半径。 / Keep radius and altitude separate. 2. 地月间最小发射能量由起点到 沿途最大势能 的增量决定，不一定是到目的地的净势能差，也不一定要达到无穷远。 / Check the energy barrier along the path. 3. 非圆轨道用 E_{total}=\frac12mv^2-GMm/r ；不要套仅适用于圆轨道的 E=-GMm/(2r) 。 / Retain the general energy equation for an elliptical trajectory. 4. 若无耗散，初速度相同的不同质量岩石达到同一高度，因动能、势能都与物体质量成正比。 / Demonstrate cancellation rather than merely asserting equal height. 对应真题 / Examples： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/06 真题练习/按试卷/202101/PH03 202101 Q01 题目 Concept / 概念 - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/02 知识节点/概念与定义/3.7.4 公转周期 orbital period orbital period — 公转周期 - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/02 知识节点/概念与定义/3.7.4 地球同步轨道 geosynchronous orbit geosynchronous orbit — 地球同步轨道 - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/02 知识节点/概念与定义/3.7.4 地球静止轨道 geostationary orbit geostationary orbit — 地球静止轨道 Definition / 定义 Physics diagram Physics diagram Physics diagram 定义按考纲与指定教材概括；本页未列出可直接对应的定义题评分条目。 Definitions are summarised from the specification and textbook; no directly matched definition-item citation is claimed here. Formula / 公式与单位 较高圆轨道速率更小、周期更长，总能量较高但仍为负。 GMm/r^2=mv^2/r ; v=\sqrt{GM/r} ; T^2=4\pi^2r^3/(GM) ; E_k=GMm/(2r) ; U=-GMm/r ; E_{\mathrm{total}}=-GMm/(2r) . Conditions / 条件与范围 采用中心质量占主导的圆轨道并忽略阻力；同步周期为地球一自转周期，通常计算近似 24 小时。 Use circular orbits around a dominant central mass and neglect resistive forces. Earth-synchronous period is one sidereal rotation, approximately 24 h for usual calculations. Explanation / 解释 圆轨道速度与周期 / Circular orbit speed and period 仅引力提供向心力时 GMm/r^2=mv^2/r ，故 v=\sqrt{GM/r} ， T=2\pi\sqrt{r^3/(GM)} 。同一天体周围，轨道越高速度越小、周期越长；理想轨道参数与卫星自身质量无关。 Equate gravitation to the radial resultant. For the same central body, larger circular orbits have lower speeds and longer periods; the satellite's mass cancels. 先用 r=R+h 。卫星和宇航员共同自由落体，失重不等于轨道处没有重力。 Use orbital radius, not altitude. Apparent weightlessness occurs because craft and occupants are in free fall, not because gravity is absent. 轨道能量与逃逸应用 / Orbital energy and escape 圆轨道 E_k=GMm/(2r) 、 E_p=-GMm/r 、 E_{\rm total}=-GMm/(2r) 。升入更高圆轨道时总能量增大、势能增大，但最终动能和速率减小；需要输入能量，不能仅比较末态速率。 For a circular orbit, total energy is negative. Moving to a higher circular orbit requires an increase in total energy despite the lower final speed. 课件逃逸应用：不计大气且最终在无穷远恰好静止时，总机械能为零，得 v_{\rm esc}=\sqrt{2GM/r} 。它来自能量分析，不等于该处圆轨道速度。 For the slide's escape application, neglecting drag and reaching infinity at rest gives zero total energy and v_{\rm esc}=\sqrt{2GM/r} . This differs from circular orbital speed. 同步与静止轨道 / Synchronous and stationary orbits 地球同步轨道周期与地球自转周期相同；地球静止轨道还须圆形、赤道平面内、与地球同向绕行，才在地面看来位置固定。计算按题给自转周期；近似一天时约24 h。 A geosynchronous orbit matches Earth's rotation period. A geostationary orbit must additionally be circular, equatorial and prograde so that it remains above one ground location. Use the rotation period given in the question. 通信天线可固定指向静止卫星，但远距离带来传输延迟，极区覆盖受限。不要把所有同步轨道都说成地面上空静止。 Geostationary communication permits fixed aerials, with propagation delay and limited polar coverage. Not every synchronous orbit is stationary relative to the ground. 逐项覆盖 / Requirement-by-requirement coverage： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/01 考纲框架/00 U3知识覆盖核对 - Syllabus coverage audit 3.7.4 行星和卫星的轨道 / ORBITS OF PLANETS AND SATELLITES 3.7.4 原课件图像 / Source diagrams [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram 图像按原课件来源保留，解释与公式以本页考纲范围为准。 Original teaching images are retained; the text and conditions above define the assessed scope. Applications / 应用与实验 解释静止卫星通信覆盖与固定天线，并区分同步与静止轨道。 Explain communications coverage and fixed ground dishes for geostationary satellites; distinguish general synchronous orbits from stationary ones. Common errors / 易错点 轨道半径从星球中心量起；失重来自共同自由落体而非引力场零。 Orbit radius is measured from the planet centre. Weightlessness in orbit arises from shared free fall, not zero gravitational field. 真题检验与答题思路 / Exam coverage and approaches 依据本库现有真题与评分标准核对。下列步骤按题型使用，先核对题设条件；综合题需结合其他关联知识点。 / Checked against the papers and mark schemes held in this vault; select the approach that fits the stated conditions. 3.7.4 方法 1 · 圆轨道、变轨与同步条件 / Circular orbits and orbital changes 1. 推导题从 GMm/r^2=mv^2/r=mr\omega^2 起步，结合 v=2\pi r/T ，再得到 v^2=GM/r 和 T^2=4\pi^2r^3/(GM) 。 / Show the force equation before quoting derived results. 2. 圆轨道 E_k=GMm/(2r) 、 E_p=-GMm/r 、 E=-GMm/(2r) 。降轨后动能增加、势能下降更多、总能量变得更负；制动推力移除的是总机械能。 / Distinguish a brief manoeuvre from the final circular-orbit comparison. 3. 同步需周期等于地球自转周期；静止还需赤道平面、同向且圆轨道。向东从赤道发射可利用最大地面自转速度并减少轨道平面调整。 / List the extra geostationary conditions. 4. 非圆轨道是否可能用给定 F 与 mv^2/r 比较；不能把所有引力运动当匀速圆周。总能量非负表示在孤立吸引场中不受束缚。 / State the assumed isolated-system model. 5. 附近第二天体的引力可能提供额外向心分量，使轨道偏离单一天体的开普勒圆轨道关系。 / Include the fields specified in the question. 对应真题 / Examples： Concept / 概念 - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/02 知识节点/概念与定义/3.8.1 静电力 electrostatic force electrostatic force — 静电力 - A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/02 知识节点/概念与定义/3.8.1 真空介电常量 permittivity of free space permittivity of free space — 真空介电常量 Definition / 定义 Physics diagram Physics diagram 定义按考纲与指定教材概括；本页未列出可直接对应的定义题评分条目。 Definitions are summarised from the specification and textbook; no directly matched definition-item citation is claimed here. Formula / 公式与单位 此式给出力的大小；方向由电荷正负决定。 F= Q_1Q_2 /(4\pi\varepsilon_0r^2) . Conditions / 条件与范围 用于真空点电荷，空气可近似真空；球对称电荷分布的外部计算可把电荷集中在球心。 Apply to point charges in vacuum; air can be treated as vacuum. For spherical charge distributions outside the sphere, take charge at the centre. Explanation / 解释 力的大小、方向和对象 / Magnitude, direction and objects 真空中点电荷作用力大小 F= Q_1Q_2 /(4\pi\varepsilon_0r^2) ；同号相斥、异号相吸。空气通常近似真空。先用电荷符号判方向，再求大小、作矢量和。 Use the magnitude of the charge product for force magnitude; like charges repel and unlike charges attract. Air can usually be treated as vacuum. Determine directions before vector addition. 对球对称带电球体外部，可把电荷视为集中在球心；距离取球心距。不要把此近似无条件推广到任意非均匀分布或球内位置。 Outside a spherically symmetric charged sphere, use its charge at the centre. Do not apply this external model to arbitrary distributions or internal points. 与引力的比较 / Comparison with gravitation 引力和静电力都为平方反比、沿源与粒子连线；引力只吸引，静电力可吸引或排斥。两亚原子粒子的大小比为 F_e/F_g= q_1q_2 /(4\pi\varepsilon_0Gm_1m_2) ，同一距离下 r^2 抵消。 Both forces are inverse-square central forces, but gravity is always attractive. For a given particle pair their force ratio is independent of separation; electrostatic interactions are much stronger at the subatomic scale. 逐项覆盖 / Requirement-by-requirement coverage： A-level 物理/AQA（OxfordAQA 9630）/U3/01 考纲框架/00 U3知识覆盖核对 - Syllabus coverage audit 3.8.1 库仑定律 / COULOMB’S LAW 3.8.1 原课件图像 / Source diagrams [!example]- 物理示意图 / Physics diagram Physics diagram 图像按原课件来源保留，解释与公式以本页考纲范围为准。 Original teaching images are retained; the text and conditions above define the assessed scope. Applications / 应用与实验 多电荷力需矢量叠加；比较静电力和引力时统一距离。 Combine forces vectorially when several charges act on one test charge; compare F_e/F_g with consistent centre separation. Common errors / 易错点 注意距离平方和微、纳库仑换算；力大小为正不代表必然吸引。 Use squared distance and convert micro/nanocoulombs. Do not infer attraction merely because the force magnitude is positive. 真题检验与答题思路 / Exam coverage and approaches 依据本库现有真题与评分标准核对。下列步骤按题型使用，先核对题设条件；综合题需结合其他关联知识点。 / Checked against the papers and mark schemes held in this vault; select the approach that fits the stated conditions. 3.8.1 方法 1 · 库仑力与非匀强场中的功 / Coulomb forces and work 1. 画力的方向，大小用 Q_1Q_2 /(4\pi\varepsilon_0r^2) ；带电球采用题设点电荷或球对称近似， r 为中心距。 / Check the point-charge approximation and distance. 2. 两滴接触时中心距为 r_1+r_2 。接近过程力随距离改变，外力功用 \Delta E_p=Q_1Q_2(1/r_f-1/r_i)/(4\pi\varepsilon_0) ，不能用初始力乘全程距离。 / Use a potential-energy difference for a nonuniform force. 3. 正面入射最近接近时可令初动能等于电势能增量；非正面偏转的最近点速度一般不为零。 / Distinguish head-on stopping from general scattering. 4. 作比值题，先明确改变的是一个电荷还是两个电荷，并将距离变化平方。 / Write the full ratio before evaluating.
